descriptions: A gate of grey driftwood, bound with iron and left open. Roads leave from here along the coast and inland.
features: A signpost whose arms have been repainted so often the letters stand out in relief.
A gatekeeper's stool, empty, with a half-mended net draped over it.
ambient: A cart rattles past and away down the road.
Someone calls a greeting from a window, then thinks better of it.

descriptions: Tall narrow houses lean together over the street, their upper floors almost touching.
A street of fish-scale shingles and blue doors, every one of them shut.
features: A rain barrel with a dead crab floating in it.
ambient: A shutter bangs somewhere above you.

descriptions: Trestle tables under patched awnings. Most stalls sell fish; one sells only rope.
A cobbled square where traders call prices into the wind.
features: A scale with brass weights stamped with three different harbour marks.
A chalk board listing today's catch, half of it crossed out.
ambient: A trader shouts a price, then a lower one.

descriptions: Stone steps go down into green water. Boats knock against the quay on their ropes.
A long quay of black stone, slick with weed below the high-water line.
features: A bollard worn into a waist by centuries of rope.
ambient: A boat creaks against its fenders.
The tide slaps at the steps.

descriptions: A low-beamed tavern, warm and smoky, its walls hung with things the sea gave back.
A tavern built from a ship's timbers; the floor still slopes like a deck.
features: A figurehead over the hearth, her painted eyes following the door.
ambient: Somebody laughs too loudly at a corner table.

descriptions: A whitewashed chapel to a sea saint nobody can quite name.
A small chapel whose windows are bottle-glass, green and brown and blue.
features: Votive boats, folded from paper, crowd the altar rail.
ambient: A candle gutters, though the air is still.

descriptions: An open-fronted smithy hung with anchors, hooks and chain.
A forge glows in the back of a soot-black workshop.
features: An anvil with a gull's footprints pressed into the soot on it.
ambient: A hammer rings, stops, rings again.
